missing_requirements: Comparable Mars surface day/night temperature and temporal definition
Mission-specific material, mineral and operational thresholds
Site-level ground validation and finer terrain where needed

captions.terrain_distance_components: Top two stored candidates per target. Stacked terms sum to the terrain distance; lower is closer in three regional statistics only. No environmental score or confidence is implied. ETOPO 2022 / MGS MOLA; 100 km windows, 4 km sampling, 8 km slope stencil. Weights and tolerances are uncalibrated design assumptions.
captions.top2_sensitivity: Number of baseline top-two candidates retained under each setting, out of two. Weight variants use the same candidate set. The 10 km sampling run changes the eligible set, so it is a pipeline sensitivity check, not an isolated precision test or confidence estimate.

limitations: No four-theme score; no calibrated probability or mission success rate.
Novelty, minerals, climate, water/ice, accessibility and permits are unverified.
2-degree centre sampling is incomplete and latitude-dependent; polar regions excluded.
Bilinear interpolation and nominal scale matching do not establish subpixel detail.
Regional topography does not establish rover traversability or landing safety.
MOLA label reports interpolated bins and profile gaps up to 12 km near equator.
Natural Earth mask is coarse and does not exclude every inland water body.
